description: A $4.1M ARR data center hardware account faces an executive sponsor crisis when the long-standing CTO champion departs and the incoming CTO favors cloud-first over on-prem. The platform detects stakeholder sentiment reset, engagement vacuum, and competing priorities, enabling the CS team to execute a re-engagement playbook that retains $4.1M and positions a $2M hybrid expansion.

phases.name: Pre-Change Stability
phases.description: Account is healthy at 81 with a strong CTO champion who drove the original on-prem GPU infrastructure investment. All engagement metrics are green. Champion attends QBRs, responds same-day, advocates internally for expansion. No visible signs of impending disruption -- but behind the scenes, the CTO has accepted an offer elsewhere.

plot_points.description: CTO attends full QBR; approves Q3 expansion roadmap for 64 additional GPU nodes
CTO response time increases from 4h to 24h; delegates two scheduled syncs to VP Engineering
Internal rumor surfaces: CTO may be leaving. CSM picks up signal from VP Engineering's offhand comment about 'leadership changes'

phases.name: Leadership Transition
phases.description: Former CTO departs. Announcement triggers immediate engagement vacuum: no executive sponsor for vendor relationships, pending expansion frozen, QBR cancelled. New CTO arrives with cloud-first philosophy and questions ROI of on-prem GPU infrastructure. Champion engagement drops to zero. Budget signals freeze as new leadership reviews all vendor commitments. Health score drops sharply into at-risk territory.

plot_points.description: Former CTO departure announced; effective immediately. All pending approvals frozen including 64-node GPU expansion
Scheduled QBR cancelled by customer EA: 'New leadership needs time to assess vendor relationships'
New CTO starts. Background: 15 years at hyperscale cloud providers. First all-hands mentions 'cloud-first modernization strategy'
New CTO requests full infrastructure cost audit; asks 'Why aren't we using cloud GPUs?' in leadership meeting. VP Engineering relays concern to CSM

phases.name: Engagement Reset
phases.description: CS team initiates re-engagement protocol. CSM escalates to CRO for executive-level outreach. CRO requests introduction meeting with new CTO through board connection. VP Engineering serves as internal bridge, providing intelligence on new CTO's priorities. First face-to-face with new CTO is cautious but productive. Health stabilizes in low at-risk territory.

plot_points.description: CSM escalates to CRO with full stakeholder analysis: champion lost, new decision maker skeptical, $4.1M at risk. Platform fires 'Executive Sponsor Change' risk alert

csm_action.description: Prepare executive briefing with stakeholder map, revenue-at-risk analysis, and new CTO profile assessment

plot_points.description: Platform's causal graph identifies convergence of 5 risk signals: champion departure + engagement vacuum + QBR missed + budget freeze + competing cloud-first priority
CRO secures executive introduction meeting with new CTO through mutual board connection; 45-minute slot confirmed

csm_action.description: CRO-to-CTO introduction meeting; bring hybrid architecture positioning deck and TCO comparison data

plot_points.description: First CRO-New CTO meeting: cautious but productive. New CTO expresses interest in 'proving hybrid value' before committing to cloud migration. Agrees to a 6-week hybrid architecture assessment

phases.name: Value Re-Demonstration
phases.description: Hybrid architecture assessment executed. Technical team demonstrates that on-prem GPU cluster delivers 40% lower latency for inference workloads and 35% lower TCO at current scale vs. cloud alternatives. New CTO impressed by data but wants to see a hybrid roadmap that incorporates cloud burst capability. VP Engineering champions the hybrid approach internally. Health recovers above 70 threshold.

plot_points.description: Deploy hybrid architecture assessment team: 2 solution architects on-site for 3 weeks to benchmark on-prem vs. cloud GPU performance

csm_action.description: Deploy solution architect team for hybrid architecture assessment; run head-to-head cloud vs. on-prem benchmarks on customer's actual workloads

plot_points.description: Assessment results delivered: on-prem GPU shows 40% lower inference latency, 35% lower TCO at current scale. Cloud burst capability mapped for peak workloads. New CTO says 'This changes my calculus'
VP Engineering presents hybrid roadmap to new CTO and CFO; positions on-prem as 'performance foundation' with cloud burst for peak training jobs
CFO approves unfreezing infrastructure budget based on TCO data; new CTO lifts vendor review hold on GPU hardware contracts

phases.name: New Champion Cultivation
phases.description: New CTO transitions from skeptic to advocate. Signs strategic partnership agreement for hybrid infrastructure. Expansion discussion reopened: $2M hybrid expansion pipeline covering on-prem GPU cluster + cloud burst orchestration layer. Full QBR cadence restored. Health score exceeds pre-crisis level as relationship resilience is proven. The system demonstrated it detected the sponsor change risk within days and enabled a $4.1M save.

plot_points.description: New CTO signs 2-year strategic partnership agreement; commits to hybrid-first infrastructure strategy. Quotes: 'The data convinced me -- hybrid is the right architecture for our workload profile'
Full executive QBR restored: new CTO, CFO, VP Engineering attend. Joint roadmap presented covering 48-node GPU expansion + cloud burst orchestration. $2M hybrid expansion formally enters pipeline
New CTO presents at industry conference citing hybrid GPU infrastructure as competitive advantage; becomes vocal external advocate. Health score reaches 83 -- exceeding pre-crisis baseline

CSM sends cold outreach email to new CTO requesting introductory call

decisions.title: Propose Hybrid Architecture Assessment

options.option: Defend on-prem only -- argue against cloud entirely (alienates cloud-first CTO)
Propose 6-week hybrid assessment: benchmark on-prem vs. cloud on customer's actual workloads, present TCO and latency data
Offer steep discount to retain current footprint without addressing cloud concerns

decisions.outcome_description: Hybrid positioning met the new CTO where he was -- acknowledging cloud benefits while proving on-prem value for specific workloads. Assessment data (40% lower latency, 35% lower TCO) convinced both CTO and CFO. Positioned us as strategic partner rather than legacy vendor.

CFO approved budget unfreeze based on TCO data
P5-KPI8 rebuilt from 0 to 72 (new CTO champion engagement)
decisions.outcome_description: New CTO signed 2-year strategic partnership, committing to hybrid-first infrastructure. $4.1M ARR retained plus $2M hybrid expansion pipeline. Relationship proved resilient -- CTO converted from skeptic to advocate in 18 weeks.

outcomes.title: Full ARR Retained Through Sponsor Change
outcomes.evidence: 2-year strategic partnership signed at $4.1M ARR; new CTO committed to hybrid infrastructure strategy after assessment data proved on-prem value

outcomes.title: Replacement Cost Avoided
outcomes.evidence: Avoided estimated $615K customer replacement cost (CAC at $410K + onboarding at $125K + revenue gap during 4-month ramp at $80K)

outcomes.title: Hybrid Expansion Pipeline Created
outcomes.evidence: $2M hybrid expansion pipeline: 48-node on-prem GPU cluster expansion ($1.4M) + cloud burst orchestration layer ($600K); entered formal pipeline at QBR in week 28

outcomes.title: Relationship Resilience Proven
outcomes.evidence: Health score recovered from 58 (at-risk) to 83 (healthy), exceeding pre-crisis baseline of 81. New CTO engagement score reached 81, surpassing former CTO's 78. Relationship survived complete executive turnover.

outcomes.title: Net ROI of CS Intervention
outcomes.evidence: $4.1M ARR saved minus $395K intervention cost = $3.705M net value. 920% ROI on CS investment. Intervention cost breakdown: escalation prep $12K, executive engagement $25K, hybrid assessment $145K, travel/on-site $65K, retention package negotiation $148K.
